svg.text: STM32 IoT Coffee Maker — Physical Breadboard Wiring Diagram

g.text: Red: CN2 pin 4 (+3.3V) → Breadboard Red Rail
Blue: CN2 pin 6 (GND) → Breadboard Blue Rail
Light Blue: CN4 pin 1 (PC5) → Pot Wiper
Green: CN3 pin 6 (PB4) → 150 Ω → Ready LED
Amber: CN3 pin 7 (PB1) → 330 Ω → Heat LED
Purple: CN3 pin 8 (PA4) → 330 Ω → Fault LED
PA3 to COM; ground one outer throw; leave the other open.
Identify COM and throws with a continuity meter first.
NOT TO SCALE: use PCB silkscreen, not pin counting.
